gloss: to bounce; to be lively; to spring

forms.label: ている past polite
forms.negative: {弾|はず}んでいませんでした

definitions.explanation: For a ball or elastic object to rebound when striking a surface.

definitions.gloss: to be lively; to be animated
definitions.explanation: For conversation, mood, or breathing to become energetic or excited.
To be unusually generous with money, tips, or gifts.

examples.japanese: ⟦ボール→ボール：00017_booru⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦よく→よく：00601_yoku⟧{弾|はず}む。
⟦{会話|かいわ}→会話：01271_kaiwa⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{弾|はず}んで⟦{楽|たの}しかった→楽しい：00817_tanoshii⟧。
examples.english: The conversation was lively and fun.

examples.japanese: ⟦{子供|こども}→子供：00554_kodomo⟧たち⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{弾|はず}んだ⟦{声|こえ}→声：02207_koe⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{話|はな}している→話す：00467_hanasu⟧。
examples.english: The children are talking in lively voices.

examples.japanese: ⟦{今日|きょう}→今日：00496_kyou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{給料日|きゅうりょうび}→給料日：27561_kyuuryoubi⟧⟦だから→だから：00924_dakara⟧、⟦チップ→チップ：11019_chippu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{弾|はず}んだ。
examples.english: Since it's payday, I gave a generous tip.

⟦{走|はし}った→走る：00519_hashiru⟧⟦{後|あと}→後：09580_ato⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{息|いき}→息：02176_iki⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{弾|はず}んでいた。
examples.english: I was out of breath after running.

examples.japanese: ⟦{久|ひさ}しぶり→久しぶり：01711_hisashiburi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{会|あ}った→会う：00482_au⟧⟦ので→ので：09501_node⟧⟦{話|はなし}→話：01496_hanashi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{弾|はず}んだ。

examples.english: Saying it was a celebration, he was more generous than usual.

notes:
{弾|はず}む is primarily an intransitive verb (⟦{自動詞|じどうし}→自動詞：10977_jidoushi⟧) but can be transitive in sense 3.

ASPECT (ている):
{弾|はず}んでいる indicates something is bouncing or a lively state continues.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- [object]⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{弾|はず}む — [object] bounces
- [conversation/mood]⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{弾|はず}む — [conversation/mood] becomes lively
- [tip/money]⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{弾|はず}む — to be generous with [money]
- ⟦ボール→ボール：00017_booru⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{弾|はず}む (ball bounces)
- ⟦{会話|かいわ}→会話：01271_kaiwa⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{弾|はず}む (conversation becomes animated)
- ⟦{息|いき}→息：02176_iki⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{弾|はず}む (breathing becomes heavy from exertion/excitement)
- ⟦{心|こころ}→心：01321_kokoro⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{弾|はず}む (heart leaps with excitement)

IDIOMATIC EXPRESSION:
⟦{息|いき}→息：02176_iki⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{弾|はず}ませて (⟦{声|こえ}→声：02207_koe⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{弾|はず}ませて) means "breathlessly" or "with an excited voice."

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{跳|は}ねる→跳ねる：04378_haneru⟧: to jump, leap (more active)
- {弾|はず}む: to bounce, be lively (includes liveliness)
